opportunities.title: Henry Moore Grants

amount.raw: Maximum grant available: £20,000 (New Projects and Commissions, Acquisitions and Collections, Long-Term Research); £5,000 (Conferences, Lectures and Publications); £2,500 (Research and Travel)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK and international non‑profit organisations for most categories; individuals (sculpture historians, academics, conservators) for Research and Travel grants.
opportunities.summary: Supports the growth and development of sculpture across historical, modern and contemporary registers, funding exhibitions, commissions, research, publications, acquisitions, conservation and related activities.

opportunities.title: Visiting research fellowships

amount.raw: UK – up to £600; Europe – up to £700; Rest of world – up to £1,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Researchers (academics, curators) focusing on historic and contemporary sculpture; artists for Artist Research Fellowships; senior scholars for Senior Fellowships.
opportunities.summary: Fellowships enable artists and researchers to spend a month using the Henry Moore Institute or Studios & Gardens facilities, including accommodation, travel and subsistence expenses.
